title: Registered launcher run with a cargo clippy lint stage reports "unclassified_stages / native verification not granted", twice
outcome: The host recognises the launcher's lint stage (`cargo clippy … -D warnings`) on a registered committed-input run, and reports its credit disposition precisely: a passed lint check credited as lint, a failed one as a failed lint. It does not treat it as unclassified, and it emits each notice once.
acceptance: A registered committed-input launcher run whose original stage kind is lint, with the command `cargo clippy --locked -j 1 --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, is classified as a lint check, and its credit disposition (passed, failed or not eligible, with reason) is reported instead of `unclassified_stages`.
The host emits that disposition notice once per run, not twice; a behaviour test that fails before the fix shows a single notice for one terminal lint run.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
